note: The 0.1.9 release-time evidence was collected on Windows x64; this pass re-verifies the same code paths on macOS arm64. It does not claim Windows acceptance.

C3.method: real log shows [SLOW >1000ms] on >=1000 ms stages plus per-trace total and slowest stage

findings.summary: 0.1.9 renamed the project runtime's official exportDiagnostics method to exportLogs. The pinned Host dispatches native:exportDiagnostics by name through bindNativeRuntime, so the official 'Export Diagnostics…' menu entry failed with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'apply'), and it sat beside the Shell's own entry as a second export path.
findings.verification: tests/desktop-runtime-contract.test.mjs (5/5, and it fails when the old name is restored) + real end-to-end run: the menu has one export entry, and both the Shell entry and the official renderer action produce report + archive

findings.summary: .upstream/project held an older export missing the d45b54f changes, so yarn check stopped in verify:upstream ('Expected f8fe0b42...; found dcd0f0e8...'). Re-exported from the pinned commit; tree now f8fe0b42 and verify:upstream passes.
findings.fixedBy: re-export (no commit; the snapshot is gitignored)

findings.summary: scripts/native-smoke-case.mjs dereferenced readTitlebarLocale(), which returns null on darwin, so probe:startup-trace always exited 1 on macOS even though its 7 trace checks passed.
findings.verification: the locale check moved into native-titlebar-checks.mjs checkTitlebarLocale() behind the DARWIN_SKIP guard; probe:startup-trace now reports 7/7 and native smoke case exit code 0 (probe EXIT=0)

findings.summary: exportStartupLog's trace.event('logs exported') was dropped because the boot trace had already ended, so boot.log never recorded the export itself.
findings.verification: each export now opens its own `export` section; the end-to-end run shows two sections, each with its own total and slowest stage

commits.summary: restore the official exportDiagnostics contract and merge the duplicate export entry
record each export in its own trace section; stop the macOS smoke probe from failing on the titlebar locale check
